title: Opening the peer link to others: relay URL variable, create keys, counts, registration (2026-10-29)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
what if someone else wants to set up a peer?

lets make sure that the relay url is a variable. 

I need to be able to see how many relays are created. 
Also, how would I be able to manage handing out a key that would allow me to manage create access? 

Eventually I could make signup a paid service, but for now, it would just require a registration with a simple privacy statement and terms of service

I have enabled resend.com on the domain

Send me (greenman@the-organization.com) a weekly update email if there are new subscribers
